title: ProductAcquisitionFact
description: Kiorex tells a partner product (Pharmacy, Lab, Nurse) how an order or booking that Kiorex took on its public page was acquired (1.12.0; used by Phase 4 package P4-B). Mirror of the Clinic acquisition block: origin, reason, decision and policy references, evidence hash. It can only remove a fee, never add one; today pharmacy and lab take rates are 0. Never patient data.

orgRef.description: Organisation (tenant) reference that owns the link code; the same value the signed `lt` carries as `o`. Additive in 1.11.0 on ReferralLinkCreated (optional there); required on ReferralLinkRevoked.

orderRef.description: The partner's own reference of the order or booking (opaque).

origin.description: Commission-relevant acquisition origin decided by the Kiorex attribution function (additive in 1.10.0). Absent = UNATTRIBUTED and today's rules apply.

decisionId.description: Id of the Kiorex AttributionDecision (or the Clinic CommissionDecision) that explains the outcome. Additive in 1.10.0.

policyVersion.description: Version id of the ATTRIBUTION_POLICY config that was ACTIVE at decision time. Additive in 1.10.0.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
